group.title: Pilot-build instructions
group.passage:
To: Pilot-build team
Subject: Sensor module trial

We will assemble fifty sensor modules on Tuesday. Before work begins, please [131] ____ that your workstation has revision C of the work instruction. The updated document contains a clearer photograph of the cable connection.

The first five units must be inspected [132] ____ production continues. Quality staff will check connector orientation and record the results. [133] ____

Please keep any rejected parts in the red tray rather than returning them to stock. This will prevent their [134] ____ reuse. Contact the shift leader if a step is unclear.
